_comment: fp16 rcr config with pad_m/n/k=true for T1.6 padding code path verification.
_comment2: Use non-tile-aligned K that is still a multiple of 8 (fp16 vector load size). K=56 (56%8=0, 56%32=24) exercises pad_k without hitting the unconditional vectorSize alignment check in IsSupportedArgument(). K=257 and K=33 are rejected because 257%8=1 and 33%8=1.
